## Project Primary Configuration Files (JSON)
Each project in the Prismata workspace contains a manifest file defining the projects capabilities.

The manifest file will be placed in each respective projects root folder /{$PROJECT_NAME}

The manifest file will be named based on the project name, in matched casing, and with the appended suffix "_MANIFEST.yaml"

Manifest file: {$PROJECT_NAME}_MANIFEST.yaml

Grouped project manifests are placed under /Prismata/.workspace/projects.manifests
